uncited: **Coarse Mesh Construction:** The coarse mesh is built from a subset of the dataset's elements.
In [Varying Refinement Levels of Coarse Elements](1055-varying-refinement-levels-of-coarse-elements.md), this involves selecting elements at a specific refinement level $k$ or leaf nodes.
**Macrocell Culling:** Each coarse element (macrocell) stores a summary statistic, such as the maximum density `macrocellValues`.
**Nested Traversal:** When a coarse element is active, the algorithm enters a nested loop.
It samples the fine structure (e.g., tetrahedra) within the bounds of the coarse element.
